sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Adult woman in a chest-up portrait, near frontal with a slight screen-left head turn and gaze near the viewer, softly raised dark brows and a relaxed slightly parted mouth. Short voluminous warm-brown hair forms distinct rolled curls over the forehead and around the sides; no hat, eyewear, moustache or chin hair is visible. Mustard/olive small-check civilian blouse or jacket, pointed folded collar closed at the neck and two visible reddish-brown front buttons. Her raised hand on screen-right holds a long slender dark cigarette holder diagonally toward the upper-right, with a pale cigarette end and curling light-gray smoke above it; retain the actual finger pose and the gap between hand and face. No visible medals. Keep the original bust crop, gentle upper-left/front light, facial and collar shadows, and complete gray-brown painted background with darker upper corners and a lighter area behind the shoulders. No separate photo frame, note, caption, or exterior cutout: the full original rectangular backing is visible. Exact156x210 PNG and nearest4/nearest6 details were actually observed. Fine fabric weave and tiny cigarette-tip pixels do not establish further detail; do not invent it. Measured source alpha254..255 with no transparent pixels; retain the full backing under visible-alpha-v1 and judge only visible source features under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Adult woman in a chest-up portrait with a slight screen-left head turn, composed closed mouth and dark arched brows. Dark reddish-brown hair sweeps upward into large waved rolls over the forehead and is drawn back around the sides. Large round spectacles have dark/gold rims, a thin gold bridge and gold side arms, with bright reflected lens areas; preserve the spectacles and the actual reflections without inventing a precise eye direction hidden by them. No hat or facial hair is visible. A gray civilian jacket has broad shiny folded lapels over a teal-blue blouse/scarf, gathered high at the neck and tied into a broad asymmetric bow with a long folded end extending across screen-right. No visible medals or raised hands. Preserve the bust crop, near-frontal shoulder placement, soft upper-left/front illumination and original shaded gray-brown painted background filling every edge of the rectangle. No separate card frame, note, caption or exterior cutout. Exact156x210 original and nearest4/nearest6 details were actually observed. Lens glare limits tiny eye detail; it is an evidence limit rather than a new accessory or appearance claim. Measured source alpha254..255, no transparent pixels, with full backing retained under visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Adult woman in a chest-up portrait, face turned slightly screen-left, with a calm neutral mouth, dark brows and no visible moustache or chin beard. Black hair is tightly arranged in narrow braided rows along the scalp and drawn back into a rounded low rear roll visible on screen-right; do not replace this with loose curls or a hat. Round dark-brown framed glasses have smoky brown lenses through which the eyes are only faintly visible; retain their circular rims, bridge and side arms without asserting tiny eye details. Deep plum-purple civilian garment has closely spaced horizontal/diagonal ribbed bands, broad overlapping diagonal folded collar/lapel edges forming a modest V at the neck and one dark front button near the lower crop. No visible medals or raised hands. Keep the slight turned pose, original bust crop, soft light from upper-left/front, dark clothing folds, and full gray-brown shaded painted background. No photo frame, note, caption or external cutout. Exact156x210 PNG and nearest4/nearest6 details actually observed; tiny braid crossings and lens-covered eyes have limited resolution, so no finer pattern or gaze is invented. Measured source alpha254..255 with no transparent pixels; preserve the backing under visible-alpha-v1 and apply visible-source-differences-v1 to unreadable small details.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Adult woman in a chest-up portrait with near-frontal shoulders, slight screen-right face turn and gaze directed somewhat screen-right, dark arched brows and a relaxed closed or very narrowly parted mouth. Brown shoulder-length waved curls appear under a large warm-brown hat with a rounded crown and broad asymmetrically tilted brim extending especially far to screen-right. No eyewear or facial hair is visible. Large gold oval drop/hoop earrings hang beside the cheeks. Mustard-gold civilian coat has broad pointed folded lapels and one large dark circular front button with a pale ring near the bottom of the crop. Her raised hand on screen-left holds a long slender dark cigarette holder angled up toward screen-left, with a pale tip and curling gray smoke against the upper-left background; preserve finger pose and the hand-to-cheek gap. No visible medals. Retain original bust crop, upper-left/front highlight on hat/face/coat, deeper shadows under the brim and curls, and the complete gray-brown painted rectangle behind her. No separate card frame, paper note, caption or silhouette cutout. Exact156x210 source and nearest4/nearest6 details actually observed. Tiny earring interior and cigarette-tip pixels do not justify invented decorative details. Measured source alpha254..255, no transparent pixels; retain the full backing under visible-alpha-v1 and use visible-source-differences-v1 for specific resolution limits.
